visualCharacteristics: Repeating look-alike linked logo items that flow in a scroller -> Cards.
contentPattern: Logo-only tiles (no text), dense horizontal scroller.
usage: One row per brand: cell 1 logo image, cell 2 brand link (e.g. [ABUS](/marque/abus)). Rendered as a dense horizontal scroller of white logo tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use for partner/brand logo strips. For cards with text use cards-teaser.
